description: Wrap coverage report. Lists every agent credential, egress route, tool and lattice grant of a deployment with the wrap that governs it and flags the entries no wrap governs.

cca.summary: Every credential, egress route and tool of a deployment sits inside a declared wrap or the report exits 1.
use_when: auditing a deployment for entries outside every wrap
gating CI on zero unmatched entries
avoid_when: never treat a neutralized catch-all as matched
